The individual known only as '''Idret''' was an [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] agent active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Reputed to have ferreted out and neutralized hundreds of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Spy/Legends|intelligence operatives]] from one end of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to the other, he was placed in charge of operations concerned with eliminating spies who operated on behalf of movements opposed to the Empire in the [[Maldrood sector/Legends|Maldrood sector]]. After the executions of thirty [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] spies by the Empire, a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] of 500,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] was offered for the capture of Idret.
